introduction.text: ScaleSight ("ScaleSight," "we," "our," or "us") provides managed analytical planning services to growing businesses.
We respect your privacy and believe you should understand what information we collect, how we use it, and what choices you have.
This Privacy Notice explains how personal information is handled when you visit **www.scalesight.org**, contact us, schedule a conversation, or communicate with ScaleSight about our services.

blocks.text: We may collect information in the following ways.
**Information you provide directly**
When you submit an enquiry, schedule a meeting, or communicate with us, this may include:

items: Your name and business email address.
Your company name, website, and professional role.
Information about your sales channels or upcoming business decisions.
Messages and other details you choose to share.

blocks.text: **Website and technical information**

When you visit our website, certain technical information may be processed, including your IP address, browser type, device information, pages visited, and basic website activity, depending on our hosting, security, and analytics configuration.
**Business contact information**

We may also obtain professional contact details from publicly available business websites, professional networks, and business-information providers when researching companies and communicating about services that may be relevant to them.
This may include a professional's name, job title, company, business contact information, and publicly available professional information.
We process information for purposes including:

items: Responding to enquiries and arranging conversations.
Understanding your business requirements and evaluating whether our services are suitable.
Preparing proposals, demonstrations, and potential engagements.
Managing professional relationships and relevant business communications.
Maintaining the security and functionality of our website.
Understanding and improving website performance where analytics are enabled.

blocks.text: We use information only for purposes supported by an appropriate legal basis where required by applicable law.

Depending on the activity and jurisdiction, these bases may include taking steps before entering a contract, pursuing legitimate business interests, fulfilling legal obligations, or obtaining consent where necessary.
ScaleSight may contact business representatives about relevant planning and analytical services, subject to applicable marketing and privacy laws.
If you do not wish to receive these communications, you may request that we stop by replying to the message or contacting us using the details below.
We will respect applicable objections and opt-out requests. We may retain limited information necessary to prevent further unwanted contact.
We may use third-party service providers to help operate our website, manage communications, process enquiries, arrange appointments, and maintain business records.
Depending on the tools in use, these may include website hosting services, email providers, scheduling services, and analytics providers.
These providers may process information in connection with delivering their services.
We may also disclose information when required by applicable law or when reasonably necessary to protect legal rights, prevent misuse, or address security incidents.
[Before publication, confirm whether ScaleSight sells personal information or shares it for third-party advertising, and include an accurate statement here.]
Our website may use cookies or similar technologies to support essential functionality, remember preferences, protect forms, and understand website activity.
Where optional analytics or tracking technologies are used, we will provide relevant information and obtain consent where required by applicable law.

The current website application does not set optional analytics cookies or connect to an external analytics provider. The Calendly widget loads when you visit the contact page and may use its own cookies; its privacy notice explains its practices. Hosting and security providers may process technical information needed to deliver and protect the website.
You can also manage certain cookies through your browser settings.

You can schedule a conversation directly through the Calendly booking widget on our contact page. Calendly collects the information needed to arrange the meeting, such as your name, email address and selected time.
If you choose to schedule a conversation using an external booking provider, that provider may collect and process the details needed to arrange your meeting under its own privacy terms.
**Booking provider:** Calendly. Read Calendly’s privacy notice: https://calendly.com/legal/privacy-notice
Please avoid submitting confidential business records, personal financial details, or sensitive information through the booking widget or general contact email.
Some ScaleSight engagements involve analysing information about sales, inventory, purchase orders, production schedules, and supply commitments.
Such operational information is distinct from ordinary website enquiry data.

Where an engagement involves confidential business information or personal data, the applicable service agreement, confidentiality arrangements, and any required data-processing terms will describe how that information is accessed, processed, retained, and handled.
The website booking widget and general contact email are not intended as secure channels for transferring client operational datasets.
We retain personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary for the relevant business purpose, subject to applicable legal, contractual, and recordkeeping requirements.
Retention depends on the nature of the information, the status of the relationship, and whether further storage is necessary.
We take appropriate steps to protect personal information against unauthorized access, loss, misuse, or disclosure, taking account of the systems and providers we use.
No method of internet transmission or electronic storage can be guaranteed to be completely secure.
ScaleSight operates from Pakistan and may communicate with businesses in other countries.
Personal information may be processed or accessed in countries where ScaleSight and its relevant service providers operate.
Where applicable data protection laws require safeguards for international transfers, we will use appropriate arrangements for those transfers.
[Before publication, identify relevant service-provider processing locations and verify any legally required transfer safeguards.]
Depending on your location and applicable law, you may have rights to request:

items: Access to personal information held about you.
Restriction of, or objection to, certain processing.
Withdrawal of consent where consent is the basis for processing.
A copy or transfer of certain information where applicable.

blocks.text: You may also have the right to lodge a complaint with a relevant data protection authority.
To make a privacy-related request, contact us using the email address below. We may need to verify your identity before fulfilling certain requests.
Our website may contain links to external websites, demonstrations, professional platforms, or booking services.
These external services operate under their own privacy practices. We encourage you to review their privacy notices before providing information.
We may update this Privacy Notice when our website, services, providers, or legal obligations change.
The latest version will be published on this page with an updated revision date. Where legally required, we will provide additional notice of material changes.
For questions about this Privacy Notice, your personal information, or a privacy-related request, please contact:
